subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should `sessions.create` permanently expose the proposed tri-state `succeedsParent` contract, with keyless/dashboard children treated as parallel and omitted eligible explicit successors retaining legacy rollover?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and proven, but it establishes public gateway lifecycle semantics and compatibility behavior that source inspection cannot choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve the tri-state contract
options.body: Confirm the current additive flag and compatibility default, update the PR body to match the implementation, refresh the branch, and land after checks pass.

options.title: Use an explicit disposition enum
options.body: Replace the boolean with a named successor-versus-parallel disposition if maintainers want a clearer extensible protocol contract before release.

options.title: Keep the consumer guard only
options.body: Close this PR and retain the merged Codex-side protection if maintainers do not want to add a gateway lifecycle parameter.

recommendation.title: Approve the tri-state contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the current additive flag and compatibility default, update the PR body to match the implementation, refresh the branch, and land after checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged `sessions.create` hook work introduced the lifecycle behavior whose successor semantics are being refined.
